name.zh: DarkRP 无头服务器 GLua 任务

description.en: Multi-defect regression tasks for DarkRP, evaluated against a real headless Garry's Mod dedicated server running GLuaTest. Every task reports only user-visible symptoms and never states how many defects there are.
description.zh: DarkRP 的多缺陷回归任务，在运行 GLuaTest 的真实无头 Garry's Mod 专用服务器中评测。每道题只给出用户可见的现象，且不告知缺陷数量。

title.en: DarkRP: a release branch that missed a batch of fixes
title.zh: DarkRP：漏掉一批修复的发布分支

summary.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in the DarkRP gamemode.
summary.zh: 诊断并修复 DarkRP 游戏模式中报告的全部问题。

brief.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in the DarkRP gamemode.
brief.zh: 诊断并修复 DarkRP 游戏模式中报告的全部问题。

en: Fix the underlying causes rather than suppressing the symptoms.
Preserve the behaviour of every code path that already works.
zh: 修复根本原因，而不是掩盖现象。
保持所有已经正常的代码路径的既有行为。

en: Use the DarkRP and Garry's Mod APIs already present in the tree.
zh: 使用代码树中已有的 DarkRP 与 Garry's Mod API。

en: Every private GLuaTest assertion must pass on a headless server without network access.
zh: 所有私有 GLuaTest 断言必须在无网络的无头服务器中通过。
